title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 58-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well and denies any acute symptoms such as swelling, fatigue, or changes in urination. He has been adherent to his current medication regimen and reports stable blood pressure readings at home. He is here to monitor his renal function and discuss ongoing management.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. He appears in no acute distress. Skin is warm and dry. Heart rate is 72 beats per minute, and blood pressure is 128/82 mmHg. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema is noted.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 2.

Plan
The patient will continue his current medication. We will monitor his renal function through laboratory testing at the next visit. He was instructed to maintain a heart-healthy diet and continue regular exercise. Follow-up in three months.
